mem.9:
Conversation between Sam and Evan — memory through 27 August 2023

**18 May 2023**
- Evan returned from a family hiking trip in the Rockies, loved the scenery, and shared a lake/mountain photo. His old Prius broke down; he repaired and sold it, then got a new Prius.
- Sam loves hiking but hadn’t gone in years; recalled a meaningful hike with their dad at age 10 and shared a photo of a man and child in a forest.
- Sam was considering painting to relax. Evan had painted watercolors for years after a friend introduced him; it helped him de-stress. He shared a cactus/desert painting and offered advice. They also shared a sunset photo with feet on a car dashboard and planned to catch up.

**24 May 2023**
- Evan took his family to Jasper the previous weekend, drove the Icefields Parkway, saw glaciers and lakes, and stayed in a mountain cabin. He called it peaceful. He said he shared a glacier photo, though its description was a person holding a book by a lake. Sam had never visited and thought it looked breathtaking.
- Sam had a tough week; a disappointing weight reading at a doctor’s check-up prompted them to reconsider habits and ask for tips. Evan recommended enjoyable exercise and small dietary changes. Painting might help with stress but not weight loss; Sam planned to paint without pressure.

**6 June 2023**
- Evan said life felt like a rollercoaster after frightening heart palpitations the prior week prompted lifestyle reflection; shared a person holding medicine.
- Sam was trying to eat healthier (shared vegetables and milk). Evan avoided processed foods and sugary snacks but liked ginger snaps; Sam liked soda and candy. Evan suggested flavored seltzer and high-cocoa dark chocolate; Sam would try gradual changes.
- Evan offered to meet and teach basic exercises; Sam was keen. Sam complained supermarket self-checkouts were broken; Evan sympathized.

**27 July 2023**
- Friends mocked Sam’s weight the previous Friday, upsetting them and motivating change. Evan apologized, offered support, and suggested working on health together.
- Evan said he’d struggled with health a few years earlier and stuck with changes. He shared five “let it shine” cards, calling one a gym membership card/reminder of commitment. He emphasized diet and lifestyle as well as exercise.
- Cutting sugary snacks and eating more fruit/veg helped Evan; Sam was reducing soda/candy but found it hard. Evan suggested flavored seltzer.
- Sam asked for low-calorie snacks and the title of Evan’s gripping new mystery. Evan suggested air-popped popcorn or fruit with seltzer and named *The Great Gatsby* (despite calling it a mystery); Sam might read it. Images included fruit bowls/alcohol and a book beside a green apple. Sam valued progress over perfection.
- Evan shared a woman hiking and encouraged exercise. Sam planned regular gym visits starting the next day; Evan encouraged persistence, enjoyment, and offered support.

**7 August 2023**
- Evan had recently visited Canada and met an “awesome Canadian woman”; being with her made him feel alive and energized. Shared a couple walking hand-in-hand in snow. Sam congratulated him and mentioned his health issues. Evan called the relationship a nice change and shared cookies, saying ginger snaps were his weakness. Sam assumed a woman and child on a swing were his children; Evan didn’t clarify.
- Evan’s health journey had lasted two years with ups and downs. His family, fitness watch, adventure, and hikes motivated him; images included watch packaging/on wrist and a small island with a boat.
- Evan said anything that brings happiness can motivate. A bonsai in a black vase on a wooden table symbolized strength/resilience; caring for it helped in hard times. He stressed self-care, consistency, and perseverance. Chat ended warmly, though Sam accidentally said, “Great chatting with you, Sam!”

**13 August 2023, 4:09 pm**
- Evan returned from a great Canada vacation with his new significant other; they hiked, biked, and explored outdoors. Shared a tent in a grassy field.
- Sam said life had been challenging and affected their health; shared a notepad and pen. Their motivational quote: “Don’t fear it, just take the first step.” They felt progress mattered more than perfection. Evan encouraged celebrating small wins; Sam said little victories helped through setbacks.
- Evan had been searching for keys for half an hour and loses them weekly. Sam described a vivid dream of flying over skyscrapers and asked what it meant; Evan suggested a dream-interpretation book and said “Sweet dreams.” They encouraged each other to take things step by step.

**15 August 2023, 4:20 pm**
- Evan’s son hurt his ankle in a soccer accident the previous Saturday. Evan cared for him and took him to the doctor; it was improving but sore, nothing serious. Shared a cast photo.
- Sam had a tough week and a doctor’s appointment that was a wake-up call. They’d started a cooking class for healthier meals, learned recipes, and shared grilled salmon and vegetables. Sam offered an easy roasted-vegetable recipe; Evan wanted to eat more vegetables.
- Sam felt concerned and motivated; Evan reassured them that feeling overwhelmed was okay and praised small steps.

**19 August 2023, 6:17 pm**
- Sam was dieting and living healthier; it was tough but they were determined. Shared spinach, avocado, and strawberries. They reported more energy and less sluggishness after meals.
- Sam shared a grilled chicken-and-vegetable stir-fry recipe and offered their homemade sauce. The recipe-card image was described as a card with a drawing of a vase of flowers. Evan said he’d try it and report back.
- Evan had started painting classes a few days earlier to meet like-minded people and improve. A friend’s painting had originally inspired him years ago. He showed a forest painting, art tools, watercolors, a sunset over the ocean, and a flowering tree in a field. Classes focused on watercolor, observing nature, and painting what they see. He enjoys landscapes and nature’s peaceful feeling.
- Nature scenes reminded Evan of road trips in his “trusty car”; shared a truck in a forest. He drove somewhere fun the previous month with great views. Sam asked if he skied in Banff; Evan confirmed skiing there was great and hoped to return the next year. He enjoys skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating; shared a group skiing photo.
- Sam would like to ski but wasn’t sure their body could handle it. Evan said he’d like Sam to join him someday. Sam was uncertain due to physical limitations but appreciated his understanding.

**27 August 2023, 10:18 am**
- Sam said a new diet and exercise routine, started the previous Monday (21 August), had made a huge difference and they felt great. Evan had twisted his knee the previous Friday (25 August); it was painful and interrupted his fitness routine, which frustrated him because activity is very important to him.
- Sam sympathized, suggested low-impact exercise or physical therapy, and asked how to help. Evan said PT was planned but he was waiting for an appointment; meanwhile he was taking it easy and swimming. Sam encouraged swimming as low-impact.
- Evan mentioned a book he’d previously discussed, saying it improved with every page and he couldn’t put it down. The title is not identified in this session.
- Evan shared a photo of a car parked by a lake with mountains, from a road trip the previous month. He’d gone to the Rocky Mountains and found the scenery refreshing and relaxing.
- Sam loves nature but hadn’t taken a road trip in ages; hiking can be challenging, though they hoped becoming healthier might make it possible. Evan suggested more hikes and proposed they hike together sometime; shared a lake/mountain photo.
- Sam asked for a local lake/trail recommendation. Evan shared another lake/mountain photo, said it had many nearby trails, and was a two-hour drive away. Sam said a day trip was doable and planned to go check it out. They said goodbye warmly.
